Each draw first randomly selects either the “Common” or “Map” category, then determines the rarity using that category’s rarity rates. One card is selected with equal probability from the eligible cards in the chosen category and rarity. Standard draws and draws for watching ads have the same drop rates.
Target map: {0}. The target switches to a map when you actually set out on it.
Per-draw drop rates with the category rates already applied (shown with up to 2 decimal places).
Gacha draws now have a 70% chance of giving a card from the map you last set out on and a 30% chance of giving a “Common” card. You can check these rates under “Drop Rates”.
